knownDeltas: The crate currently freezes action, field, and text-entry semantics as token-backed GPUI specs before mounted native widgets exist for every control.
Controlled and uncontrolled value meaning, validation relationships, and disabled or loading suppression are explicit in the API even where actual event plumbing remains later runtime work.
Search-field and field-wrapper composition is frozen here so later GPUI composites reuse one contract posture instead of restating input semantics ad hoc.
nonGoals: Do not treat this tranche as proof that GPUI selection, feedback, date-time, overlay, or workstation primitives are complete.
Do not bypass field relationships or validation-state semantics with runtime-local widget shortcuts.
Do not claim full native accessibility proof from spec-level naming and relationship models alone.
